segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making the time. I wanted to walk through the renewal and the small expansion you mentioned for the operations team.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep. Current contract is 42 seats, and we need 18 more by February 3rd. Finance also asked me to confirm the invoice stays annual, not quarterly.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. The quote I sent this morning is for 60 seats total, annual billing, $54,600 for the 12-month term starting February 1st and ending January 31st next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the reporting add-on? Last year that was a separate line.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It does. It’s listed as included on line two at no additional charge for this term. Same support level as today, standard business hours, two named admins.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Our legal team only had one comment: they want the auto-renewal notice period to stay at 60 days, not move to 90.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that’s fine. The order form keeps the 60-day notice period from your current agreement. No change there.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If we sign by Friday, can your team do the admin training on January 29th? We have three supervisors who need it before go-live.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. I reserved January 29th at 11 a.m. Eastern for a 60-minute admin session. I also added the three supervisor names you sent over: Mark Ellis, Priya Shah, and Luis Romero.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the final order form to me and copy AP at the billing inbox. PO number will be 44718.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have the final order form today with PO 44718 referenced, annual invoice to the billing inbox, and the February 1st start date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll route it for signature once it lands.
